title: Lighthouse ops week communique — all-hands + Q2 OKR draft
content:
Purpose: single-sheet brief for the week of the company alignment sprint (we're calling it 'Lighthouse') — used by execs and ICs for prep, all-hands run-of-show, and the Q2 OKR proposal we want to socialize before finalization.

Summary:
- Context: usage growth continues, customers pushing Dedicated and Private trials, latency SLO incidents in Jan exposed a small routing policy gap. Ops + Product + Eng need a short window to align product priorities, comms, and a tightened reliability play.
- Goal this week: finalize top-level company OKRs for Q2, align all-hands narrative, and set three cross-functional operational commitments with owners.

High-level asks for leaders (this doc owners):
- Execs: review and sign off on the Q2 OKR draft by EOD Thursday (we plan to publish final at Friday all-hands).
- Product & Eng leads: confirm capacity for the three reliability projects and provide commit dates by Wednesday.
- Comms: draft internal all-hands script and two short customer-facing lines for Hosted API status update.

Proposed company-level OKRs (Q2 draft) — 3 objectives, each with 3 measurable KRs:
1) Objective: Make inference performance predictable at scale (Product + Serving + SRE)
   KR1: Reduce 95th percentile text-generation tail latency to <= 180ms on Hosted API baseline (current: ~240ms) measured on standard benchmark by end of Q2.
   KR2: Deploy routing policy fallback in two regions; failure recovery time for model variant fallback <= 30s during capacity events.
   KR3: Reduce per-1000-token median token cost by 10% across our top 10 customer workloads via batching and KV caching improvements.
2) Objective: Grow enterprise adoption of Dedicated and Private (GTM + Solutions + Product)
   KR1: Close 8 new Dedicated contracts (monthly commits >= $10k) with <= 45-day sales cycles.
   KR2: Complete two Private (VPC/on-prem) pilot installs with SOC2+/KMS integration validated by customer security teams.
   KR3: Launch dedicated pricing & onboarding flow in Console reducing time-to-first-serve for Dedicated to < 5 days.
3) Objective: Operationalize quality guardrails (Applied ML + Product + DX)
   KR1: Run prompt-eval suite on top 50 customer flows weekly and block any model change with >5% regression in top prompts.
   KR2: Implement automated regression alerts tied to baseline prompts with 90% signal precision.
   KR3: Create a company-wide fallback policy template for customer-facing endpoints; adoption by 100% of new routes.

Notes on measurement: primary metrics live in Dashboard: per-route latency (p50/p95), unit cost, contract signatures pipeline, pilot installs. Analytics owners: Lina (product metrics), Jordan (SRE charting), Ethan (reliability incidents tagging).

All-hands run-of-show (Friday 10:00 — 11:00 PT):
- 10:00 Intro (CEO, 5m) — high-level heartbeat; one-sentence on mission and why Lighthouse week.
- 10:05 Exec update (CTO, 10m) — state of platform, what we shipped last quarter (mentions: Dedicated GA work, routing experiments).
- 10:15 Product keynote (Head of Product, 15m) — Q2 priorities and proposed OKRs (cover each objective briefly).
- 10:30 Customer story + short clip (Customer Success, 5m) — highlight Dedicated pilot and business impact.
- 10:35 Reliability deep-dive (SRE lead, 10m) — Jan incidents, root causes, and the new fallback and observability playbook.
- 10:45 Ops asks & org changes (People Ops / Eng Managers, 5m) — hiring, rotations, on-call cadence changes.
- 10:50 Q&A (All, 10m) — trimmed; collect unanswered for follow-up doc.
- 11:00 Close (CEO)

Speaker prep bullets (for slides/talking points):
- CTO: one metric slide (latency trend), one incident learn, three asks (resources for routing/fallback, more SLO budget, prioritize eval automation).
- Product: customer-driven roadmap talk: how Dedicated and Private map to revenue, and the tradeoffs (cost vs latency vs isolation).
- SRE: incident timeline (concise), mitigation implemented, required cross-team touchpoints.
- CS: customer quote + business metric (reduced inference time => faster product flows).

Prework & comms timeline:
- Mon-Wed: team reviews OKR draft, provide KRs granularity, owners list.
- Wed EOD: final owners + commit dates due.
- Thu: Exec review meeting (30m) at 9am PT.
- Fri morning: publish final OKRs + company-wide all-hands.
- Post-all-hands: 72-hour feedback window; consolidated decision doc to be posted to Confluence.

Operational commitments (cross-functional mini-projects for Q2):
- Project A: Continuous routing fallback (owner: Jordan) — implement model-variant fallback and region-aware routing.
- Project B: Prefix/KV cache optimizer (owner: Ethan) — automated suggestions in Redwood Optimize to reduce cold-start tokens.
- Project C: Prompt-eval automation (owner: Lina) — weekly batch runs + regression pager.

Risks & mitigations:
- Risk: Overloaded eng capacity due to Dedicated GA + Private pilots. Mitigation: de-scope non-critical console features and postpone to Q3; hire contractor for infra burst.
- Risk: OKRs are too engineering-heavy and lose GTM momentum. Mitigation: add explicit revenue/contract KRs and require GTM owners for each objective.
- Risk: SLAs set unrealistic operator expectations. Mitigation: align on measured baselines before publishing SLO targets; include error budgets.

Open questions / decisions to make this week:
- Do we pin the p95 latency KR to a single baseline model instance size, or allow weighted baseline across small/large workloads? (need product + SRE thumbs by Wed)
- What is the comms line for customers about Jan incidents? Minimalist status + roadmap or detailed postmortem? (comms + legal input)
- Will Dedicated contracts prioritize latency SLOs as default or provide them as an add-on? (GTM + RevOps input)

Back-of-envelope staffing for Q2 commitments:
- Routing fallback: 1 PM, 3 SWE (serving-runtime), 1 SRE, 1 QA (3 months focused increments).
- Caching optimizer: 1 PM, 2 SWE (optimize team), 1 applied-ml, 1 data analyst (2 months).
- Prompt eval automation: 1 PM, 2 SWE (applied-ml infra), 1 SRE (ongoing).

Next steps (owner / due):
- Review OKR bullet KRs in this doc and comment inline (owner: all execs; due Wed 2025-02-12).
- SRE to post incident RCA draft + mitigation plan to linked_artifacts (owner: Jordan; due Wed 2025-02-12).
- Comms to draft all-hands script + one-pager for customers (owner: Lina; due Thu 2025-02-13).

Notes to self / roughs (informal):
- Keep the all-hands short and directional. Avoid technical deep dives outside SRE slot.
- Capture unanswered Q&A into a shared doc we can update during Q&A and publish after.
- Consider a follow-up "office hours" for Dedicated customers the week after to surface migration friction.

If you are reading this and are an owner in the list above: please add your short confirmation comment under the doc (thumbs + one line) and paste any blocking resource asks. We should converge fast this week.

-- Maya
